title: Chapter 326: The Snow Demon Tribe, Overlord Of The Snow Plain
content:
Chapter 326: The Snow Demon Tribe, Overlord Of The Snow Plain

On the vast snowfield, the biting cold wind howled, and a blizzard would come from time to time.

Wu Qing admired the snow scene that he had not seen for a long time through the Protoss' unmanned probe spacecraft.

With the anti-stealth means of the Protoss' unmanned probe spacecraft, Wu Qing could see many magical creatures that were somewhat similar to elemental life on the snowfield.

If you only look at them from a normal perspective, they are a stream of cold energy bodies, which is no different from the cold wave that is everywhere on the snow source.

These magical creatures are the super tribe of the Snow Demon Clan that defeated the local camp in the northern war zone of the evil god camp.

Through the detection and perception of the Protoss' unmanned probe spacecraft, the unpredictable energy body of the Snow Demon can be observed. From time to time, some Snow Demons will transform into other snowfield creatures and move around in the snow source.

The ability to transform into other cold-attributed creatures at will is a powerful ability of the Snow Demon Clan. Their transformation is not only similar in appearance, but also has the unique advantages of various cold-attributed creatures, which ordinary people cannot distinguish at all.

With this ability, the Snow Demon Clan has a strong adaptability. When used on the battlefield, no matter what kind of soldiers the enemy is, they can always transform into restrained creatures to deal with them.

In addition, the Snow Demon Clan's own unique energy body is very powerful in itself, and the various races in the local camp have no certain advantages against them.

However, for the Zerg and Protoss under Wu Qing, the various advantages of the Snow Demon Clan are meaningless.

There are a large number of Protoss unmanned probe spacecrafts distributed on the snowfield near the joint base of the Zerg and Protoss, which can expose all the Snow Demons.

No matter what kind of cold-attributed creature the Snow Demon transforms into, it cannot beat the joint army of the Zerg and Protoss.

A large number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions entered the snowfield. One Zerg puppies drilled under the ice layer, and another three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpion lurked in another location not far away.

A one-star snow demon wandered over. This place is considered the hinterland of the snow demon tribe. These snow demons wander around, which should be considered a way of cultivation. Their figures can be seen everywhere.

When the snow demon mixed in the cold wind floated near the Zerg puppy, the Zerg puppy immediately drilled out from under the ice layer and pounced on it.

The snow demon was not panicked when it suddenly encountered an enemy. They generally did not believe that ordinary creatures could discover them.

The snow demon was just about to observe this strange creature that suddenly appeared to see if it was possible to transform, and was pounced on by the Zerg puppy.

The snow demon, a pure energy body, looks invisible and intangible, but in fact it is still a ball of energy. The Zerg puppy's knife arm chopped it down, just like slashing a slightly sticky thing.

"Aiya...!"

A piercing scream mixed with the whistling of the cold wind spread out, and the snow demon was hurt by the attack of the Zerg puppy.

The three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpion not far away also came out and fired poisonous rays at the snow demon.

A green light shot onto the transparent energy body of the snow demon, dyeing its crystal clear body green.

"It is not immune to physical damage and energy damage, which is much worse than the weirdness!"

"Even toxins are effective against it, so it is much easier to deal with it!"

Wu Qing was watching the first confrontation between the Zerg and the Snow Demon through the Protoss unmanned explorer spacecraft.

A stream of extremely cold energy shot out from the snow demon's body and shot onto the Zerg puppy, freezing the Zerg puppy into a piece of ice.

But the body functions of the Zerg puppy were not affected by the cold at all. It just struggled lightly, and the ice covering its body shattered all over the ground.

The Zerg puppy pounced on the snow demon again.

In the Snow Demon's original state, all kinds of ice magic are instant. If it were a normal creature, it would have been frozen and lost its combat power long ago. For creatures that are not resistant to cold, an ice magic will kill them.

From this point of view alone, the Snow Demon Clan is worthy of being the overlord of the northern war zone.

Ordinary races are simply not their opponents in such an icy and snowy environment.

Unfortunately, the Snow Demon Clan is now facing two interstellar races that can roam the universe, and their methods are not good enough.

The Zerg mother nest has been upgraded to eight stars. The speed of the current Zerg puppy is very fast. Its real combat power has almost reached the peak of one star across the star level, which is enough to fight against the weak two-star race. It is very powerful.

The Zerg puppy rushed forward again, waving two arm knives. The Snow Demon could no longer resist and suddenly transformed into a huge ice man, engaging in close combat with the Zerg puppy.

The tall body of the ice man is made of extremely hard ice. It is not afraid of having the form of an ice man, but also has the strong strength and close combat ability of the ice man.

However, no matter how it changed, the snow demon with only one-star strength could not beat the Zerg puppy, and was soon beaten to death.

The snow demon changed back to its original form again and wanted to escape. The three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpion not far away fired a poisonous ray, which completely killed the snow demon and turned into a ray of light and disappeared.

"The combat power of the snow demon tribe is indeed strong!"

After this simple battle, Wu Qing could probably judge the combat power of the snow demon tribe.

This battle was the beginning of the war. From then on, countless Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions launched a large-scale annihilation operation in the hinterland of the snow demon tribe in the northern war zone.

Countless snow demons were attacked and killed on the ice field, which finally attracted the attention of the snow demon tribe.

The Snow Demon Tribe, with all its people as soldiers, began to move out in an organized manner, and finally found traces of Zerg activities. The two sides launched several large-scale encounters.

In addition to the Snow Demon Tribe, and other species living in extremely cold environments entered the area where the Snow Demon Tribe and the Zerg were fighting, and launched a siege against the already extremely large number of Zerg puppies and Type III Zerg poisonous ray scorpions.

When the Snow Demon Tribe gathered enough troops, the joint army of the Zerg and the Protoss finally set out.

Twenty Zerg air force detachments, with a strength of more than 10 million, plus a large number of unmanned Protoss reconnaissance aircraft, Protoss pirate ships, Protoss motherships and several Protoss arbitrators that mainly provide stealth support, this is a fully stealthed, extremely powerful all-air combat force.

This is also the first large-scale joint operation between the Zerg and the Protoss.

The powerful Zerg and Protoss joint forces quietly flew to the Snow Demon Clan army that was encircling the Zerg Zerglings and Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions.

The five-star Zerg Sky Guards and the five-star Zerg Devourers opened fire first, and the fierce explosion attacks and terrible mucus attacks wiped out a large number of the arrogant Snow Demons on the snowfield at once.

The special spores released by the Zerg Devourer's mucus attack are also effective against energy creatures such as Snow Demons, but the Zerg Queen tried parasitic control and found that she could not parasitize and control pure energy creatures.

However, the mental control of the Dark Executive in the Protoss made up for the lack of parasitic control by the Zerg Queen. It's a pity that the minimum strength of the Protoss troops is seven stars. Except for the unmanned troops that can be used as powerful battlefield weapons, the personnel are temporarily unable to take action.

All the Protoss spacecrafts are unmanned mode, but their essence is still seven stars. All of them are dozens or hundreds of meters large, and their combat power is extremely powerful. They brought a devastating blow to the Snow Demon Clan as soon as they took action.

The large number of missiles and naval guns fired by the Protoss reconnaissance aircraft had a much stronger explosion power than the five-star Zerg air guards, and the coverage area was extremely wide. A large number of cold-attributed snow monsters and other creatures were instantly destroyed in this high-temperature explosion.

The neutron beam attack of the Protoss pirate ship was shot at the snow monster group at a very high speed. The extremely powerful radiation damage caused continuous damage to the snow monsters in a large area around. The weaker snow monsters soon died in the strange radiation damage.

A large number of unmanned combat aircraft released by the Protoss mothership shuttled among the snow monster group, and two beam weapons were continuously fired, killing the snow monsters with extremely high efficiency.

The snow monsters had never been subjected to so many strange attacks, and they were beaten without any ability to fight back. In addition to seeing various attacks flying out of thin air, they did not even see the impact of the enemy.

Stealth attack has always been the most proud talent of the snow monsters. Unexpectedly, they enjoyed the same generation today.

Some powerful snow demons, sensing the attack coming from the air, transformed into flying ice and snow creatures and wanted to fly to fight, but they were soon attacked terribly and fell midway.

With so many powerful attacks, the plague of the Zerg scorpion and the cleaning tactics of the Zerg dragon group could not be used at all. The enemy was not strong enough to this extent, and it collapsed directly in the first wave of attack by the Zerg-Protoss coalition.

Wu Qing learned that the snow demon clan was a relatively peculiar race in the evil god camp. They believed in the gods from the snow demon clan itself. All snow demons were considered descendants of the snow demon gods, so the faith of the snow demon clan was a natural faith, not a forced faith of the mind control type.

This made every snow demon a normal creature. Having faith in their hearts could make their will more firm, but they still had the instincts of creatures and would be afraid on the battlefield.

Only those affiliated races of the snow demon genus were the kind of believers who were controlled and could not fear death at all.

The Snow Demons were facing invisible enemies, and their own invisibility seemed to be ineffective against the enemies. The Snow Demons were the most aware of the difference, so they had fear in their subconscious.

When faced with the unimaginably powerful firepower attack of the Zerg and Protoss coalition, the Snow Demons were stunned almost instantly.

After dominating the snowfield for so many years, this was the first time the Snow Demons had encountered such a situation.

"Ya...Ya...!"

The very harsh scream of "Ya" resounded throughout the battlefield, and a large number of Snow Demons began to retreat to the rear.

Those affiliated races of the Snow Demons took the initiative to move forward, trying to block the attack of the Zerg and Protoss coalition.

Unfortunately, the entire flying force of the Zerg and Protoss coalition was completely ineffective for the Snow Demons' deployment.

Two Protoss arbitrators led the Protoss reconnaissance aircraft and the Protoss pirate ship, flew directly across the battlefield in stealth, flew to the rear of the Snow Demons, and cut off the retreat of the Snow Demons.

The seven-star Protoss reconnaissance aircraft and the seven-star Protoss pirate ship were very effective against the Snow Demons, whose overall strength was not high. Most Snow Demons could not withstand even the radiation damage from the Protoss pirate ship.

The limited number of huge Protoss spacecraft could deal with a large number of Snow Demons.

The front and back attacks of the combined forces of the Zerg and Protoss quickly wiped out the large number of Snow Demons.

Wu Qing did not give the Snow Demons time to react. The combined forces of the Zerg and Protoss continued to attack and wiped out all the Snow Demons and their affiliated races near the Zerg and Protoss joint base.

The Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions quickly followed up and actually controlled a large area of snowfields.

Finally realizing that something was wrong, the Snow Demon Clan sent out strong men to enter the Zerg-occupied area to investigate the situation, but was stopped by the Berserkers and Dark Templars of the Protoss.

The Zerg already had a strong ability to collect real-time battlefield intelligence, and now there is a powerful Protoss, which further strengthens Wu Qing's ability to control the battlefield.

As long as Wu Qing doesn't want to, no one can enter the area actually occupied by the Zerg.

The area occupied by Wu Qing is only a tiny place compared to the entire northern theater, but the impact is huge.

This means that the local camp has fought back.

This is definitely something that the Snow Demon Clan, as the overlord of the northern theater, cannot tolerate. They will definitely nip this possibility in the bud.

As the overlord of the northern war zone, the power of the Snow Demon Clan burst out. Countless armies gathered in the area of the Zerg and Protoss joint base and began to encircle and suppress this powerful force that suddenly emerged.

When the Snow Demon Clan really exerted its strength, in addition to the Zerg and Protoss joint army, the Zerg children and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions could not resist at all.

The Snow Demon Clan has occupied the entire northern war zone for a long time. The environment here is extremely favorable for their cultivation, so there are a large number of high-star snow demons in the Snow Demon Clan.

The various powerful ice magics of the high-star strength snow demons can't be resisted by the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions.

The battle between the Zerg and Protoss coalition and the main force of the Snow Demon Clan also allowed Wu Qing to see the true strength of the Snow Demon Clan to dominate the northern war zone.

As soon as the two sides engaged in battle, the main force of the Snow Demon Clan, which was suddenly attacked by the Zerg and Protoss coalition, immediately cast a super-large-scale ice and snow battlefield magic. No matter what state the Zerg and Protoss armies were in, they could not escape this indiscriminate large-scale attack.

The one-star Zerg flying dragons, which were the largest in the Zerg and Protoss coalition, had to withdraw from the battlefield to avoid the powerful ice battlefield magic attack of the Snow Demon Clan.

The high-star main combat arms of the Zerg and Protoss opened fire at full force and attacked the main force of the Snow Demon Clan.

Because the average strength of the main force of the Snow Demon Clan increased, the killing efficiency of the Zerg and Protoss coalition was reduced, and the Zerg scorpion finally took action and began to create a plague area.

No matter what the strength of the Snow Demon is, it will be eliminated by the Zerg scorpion, and transformed into the energy of the Zerg scorpion, constantly creating invisible plague areas covering a huge area on the battlefield.

All creatures in the plague area, including the energy creature snow monster, will be infected by the plague, their combat effectiveness will be greatly reduced, and their lives will be continuously consumed. Weaker creatures will quickly lose their lives and die directly.
